## Model Details

This model is an MXFP8 (W8A8, group_size 32) model of [Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next) generated by [intel/auto-round](https://github.com/intel/auto-round) using RTN. Please follow the license of the original model.

- **Quantized (MXFP8)**: routed experts, attention, linear attention, shared experts
- **Kept in BF16**: embeddings, lm_head, vision tower, MTP, PLE, router

## How to Use

### Environment

```bash
uv pip install --index-strategy unsafe-best-match \
    --extra-index-url https://wheels.vllm.ai/41848caa63b131f931618055d3ece0b487ce8edb/cu130 \
    "vllm==0.28.1rc1.dev312+g41848caa6"
uv pip install transformers==5.16.1
uv pip install compressed-tensors==0.17.0
uv pip install flashinfer-python==0.6.18
```

### vLLM Usage

```bash
VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn vllm serve intel-ai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MXFP8-CT-AutoRound \
    --moe-backend marlin \
    --dtype bfloat16 \
    --language-model-only \
    --reasoning-parser qwen3 \
    --trust-remote-code
```

## Evaluation

| Benchmark | BF16 | MXFP8 | Recovery |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| PIQA | 81.94 | 82.10 | 100.20% |
| HellaSwag | 69.27 | 69.13 | 99.80% |
| MMLU | 86.52 | 85.14 | 98.40% |
| GSM8K | 96.74 | 97.04 | 100.31% |
| **Average** | **83.62** | **83.35** | **99.68%** |

## Generate the Model

```bash
uv pip install git+https://github.com/intel/auto-round.git@51003909807210189a14317e4ee09fc22bc28e73
```

```bash
auto-round \
    --model_name Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next \
    --model_free \
    --scheme MXFP8 \
    --ignore_layers visual,lm_head,embed_tokens,mlp.gate,mlp.shared_expert_gate,in_proj_a,in_proj_b,block_inject_weight,ple,mtp,hyper_connection \
    --format llm_compressor \
    --output_dir Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MXFP8-CT-AutoRound
```

## Ethical Considerations and Limitations

The model can produce factually incorrect output, and should not be relied on to produce factually accurate information. Because of the limitations of the pretrained model and the finetuning datasets, it is possible that this model could generate lewd, biased or otherwise offensive outputs.
Therefore, before deploying any applications of the model, developers should perform safety testing.

## Caveats and Recommendations

Users (both direct and downstream) should be made aware of the risks, biases and limitations of the model.
